# n3wth/skills

> Markdown skills for Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, and Copilot.

Website: https://skills.n3wth.com
GitHub: https://github.com/n3wth/skills
Contact: hey@n3wth.com

## Quick Start

```bash
npx skills add <skill-id>
```

## Skills (46 total)

### Development
- gsap-animations: ScrollTrigger, SplitText, scroll effects, and text reveals with GSAP.
- mcp-builder: Build MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that let LLMs interact with external services.
- monorepo-manager: Manage monorepo workspaces with Turborepo, Nx, or pnpm workspaces.
- skill-creator: Guide for creating effective AI coding skills with specialized knowledge and workflows.
- code-generation-pipeline: Scaffold files, validate against project standards, auto-commit with attribution.
- frontend-design: React components with intentional typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
- webapp-testing: Interact with and test local web applications using Playwright.
- canvas: Create a shareable interactive markdown canvas at canvas.n3wth.com.
- git-workflow: Git branching strategies, commit conventions, and merge-conflict resolution.
- sql-optimizer: Optimize SQL queries and database performance through execution-plan analysis.
- api-docs-generator: Generate API documentation from code. Create OpenAPI/Swagger specs.
- cicd-builder: Create CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI.
- code-reviewer: Perform thorough code reviews with security, performance, and maintainability checks.
- schema-designer: Design database schemas with proper normalization and indexing strategies.
- regex-builder: Build and test regular expressions with explanations and examples.

### Documents
- pdf: Extract text and tables from PDFs, create documents, merge and split files.
- docx: Create and edit Word documents with tracked changes, comments, formatting.
- pptx: Create, edit, and analyze presentations. Work with layouts and speaker notes.
- xlsx: Create, edit, and analyze spreadsheets with formulas, formatting, data analysis.

### Creative
- algorithmic-art: Create algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness.
- canvas-design: Create visual art in PNG and PDF using design philosophy.
- slack-gif-creator: Create animated GIFs optimized for Slack with file-size constraints.
- theme-factory: Style artifacts with themes. Ten preset themes with colors and fonts.
- typography-selector: Browse and select fonts from Google Fonts or curated pairings.
- data-viz: Create data visualizations and charts with D3.js and other libraries.

### Productivity

- imessage: Send and manage iMessages programmatically.

### Business

### Cursor Extensions

- cursor-code-review: Review code against team standards. Suggests rule improvements.
- cursor-driven-refactoring: Refactor code systematically with Cursor AI.
- cursor-git-workflow: Cursor + Git. Branch contexts, PR-based rules, pre-commit validation.
- cursor-linear-bridge: Cursor workspaces from Linear issues. Bidirectional sync, auto-generated rules.
- cursor-project-bootstrapper: Bootstrap new projects with Cursor.

- cursor-usage-analytics: Track and analyze Cursor usage patterns.
- extension-sync: Sync extensions between VSCode and Cursor.
- settings-distribution-manager: Distribute settings across team members.
- vscode-cursor-sync: Synchronize VSCode and Cursor configurations.
